name: run-marketing-impact-report
description: LFX Marketing OS Marketing Impact Report agent — asks which LF project or foundation to run against, pulls live figures through the LFX connector (required) and the HubSpot connector (optional), and writes one Word document that mirrors the Marketing Impact dashboard prototype page by page: business outcomes (All, Memberships, Events, Education, Audience, Adoption), the mediums under All (Paid, Paid › Budget, Social, Web, Direct, Attribution), goals, campaigns and source detail. Every metric tagged DECISION / SIGNAL / WATCH; every figure sourced and dated; every section without a connector kept in place with a 'Data not available, requires [x] connector' notice.

author.name: Paul Hinz, Linux Foundation — LFX Marketing OS
